notes: Seal of Fury, Holy Shield on cooldown, Holy Strike, Hammer of the Righteous and Judgement, with Consecration only on spare mana and the three defensives on low health. Righteous Fury is not a line: it is a request option (PaladinOptions.righteousFury), worth +60 percent threat on Holy damage and, with Improved Righteous Fury, up to 6 percent less damage taken. Judgement no longer consumes the seal in Forever (Blizzard's Deep Dive recap), so Seal of Fury is recast every 30 seconds rather than after each Judgement. Mana is the limiter, so every other spell leaves Holy Shield's cost (240 mana at rank 3) in the pool: Holy Shield is both the best mitigation and the best use of mana, and without the reserve a tank without Shield Specialization cast it a third as often. Measured on the engine's tank harness (sim/paladin/protection/harness_test.go: a level 60 tank in decent gear against the published tank boss for 180 seconds, 2000 iterations), threat per second against the same rotation without each line: Hammer of the Righteous +23 percent, Holy Shield +21 percent (and 5 percent less damage taken), Seal of Fury +12 percent (+1 percent over Seal of Righteousness, which also takes 2 percent more damage), Holy Strike +6 percent, Consecration +6 percent, Judgement +5 percent, Swift Judgement +1 percent. Consecration is the exception that needs the mana floor: it returns about 1 threat per mana, and in a build without Shield Specialization and Improved Seal of Fury refilling the pool it cost 9 percent of threat at a 30 percent floor and 4 percent at the 50 percent floor used here (it is a gain of 6 percent in the Forever build). The defensives on health (Templar's Bulwark below 35, Divine Shield below 25, Divine Protection below 20 percent) cut the chance of death from 47 to 11 percent against a boss hitting 1.7 times as hard as the published one; at the published boss nothing in a 180 second fight kills the tank, so there they never fire. A Seal of Righteousness, Judgement, Holy Strike and Hammer rotation with Righteous Fury off, the same gear, makes 41 percent less threat. Unconfirmed, and moving this list: Improved Seal of Fury's mana (the client prints 0, the engine assumes 1 percent of maximum mana a spent shield), Hammer of the Righteous as 120 percent of weapon damage on three targets, and Divine Protection and Divine Shield under their Classic Era ids.

priorityList.notes: Lay on Hands is the survival cooldown of last resort and fires itself below 10 percent health.

Templar's Bulwark, an absorb of the paladin's whole health bar for 8 seconds, as the first panic button: low health is when a late shield buys the most, and it puts Forbearance on the next two defensives for a minute.
Divine Shield: 12 seconds of immunity at half damage dealt, the second panic button once Forbearance from the first has gone.
Divine Protection: 8 seconds of immunity with no attacks, the last resort.
Seal of Fury kept up. Judgement no longer consumes the seal in Forever, so this recasts every 30 seconds, and only with Holy Shield's mana left over.
Holy Shield on cooldown: its 10 second cooldown equals its duration, so it is up whenever its four charges last, and it is the first claim on mana.
Holy Strike on cooldown: the cheapest threat per mana the paladin has (20 mana).
Hammer of the Righteous on cooldown, once the Holy Shield mana is safe.
Swift Judgement while Judgement is on cooldown: it finishes the cooldown and makes the next Judgement free, one more Judgement a minute.
Judgement on cooldown (an off-the-global cast of 6 percent of base mana).
Exorcism on Undead and Demons only; the engine refuses it on any other target.
Consecration last and only above half mana: about one threat per mana against ten for Hammer of the Righteous, so it is the use of mana the tank has to spare.

expected_idle.reason: Holy Shield needs a shield and the ladder's character carries none (a paladin's off hand is a weapon slot only for dual-wielding classes), so the engine refuses the cast at every level. A tank in the tank fight, shield on, casts it every 10 seconds.

Exorcism only lands on Undead or Demon (sim/paladin/exorcism.go's ExtraCastCondition); the published tank boss, like the ladder's target, has no creature type, so this line's gate structurally can never pass against it.
